payload.instruction: Move the book behind the flower
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the book visibly positioned behind the flower, with the flower in front of it?
node.criteria: Pass if the image shows the flower in front of and occluding the book in a way that establishes the book is behind it. Fail if the image clearly shows the book is not behind the flower. Unknown if the relative depth or occlusion cannot be determined from the image.
node.binding: Assess only the book’s and flower’s relative positions and visible occlusion in the edited image.

node_traces.evidence: In the edited image, the book and flowers are separate and do not overlap; neither flower occludes the book to establish that it is behind one.

fulfillment: The node’s binding is truncated/ambiguous (“visibly (…)”) and should explicitly anchor the requested relation to the original book and flower and assess their relative depth/occlusion in the edited image. Here, the edited image shows the book and flowers separated, with no flower in front of or occluding the book; the flowers’ changed appearance is unrelated. The two valid, queried checks independently report fail with strong confidence, and the aggregate correctly labels no, so do not alter the criterion to force a different label. Preserve the existing pass/fail/unknown routing and partial-progress logic: distinguish actual movement toward the requested placement from unrelated edits, and retain unknown when evidence is insufficient. No transport, schema, or dependency failure is indicated.
s2: The binding is truncated in the supplied node summary, so make the typed binding explicitly compare the same book and flower across the source and edited images, checking whether their relative position or depth/occlusion shows movement toward the book being behind the flower. In this example, the edited image changes the scene substantially (including the flower’s appearance/count and the book’s presentation), but the book remains separate from the flowers; those unrelated changes are not progress. Preserve the existing partial-progress criterion and pass/fail/unknown routing: count only visual evidence of movement toward the requested relation, fail when clearly absent, and retain unknown when the comparison is inconclusive. The observed fail and aggregate “no” agree with the rubric; do not tune the criterion to force another label. The trace is valid and queried with no transport, schema, or dependency failure indicated.
